answer: Whisper Windows delay identity activation by 24 hours after initial registration, requiring new agents to wait before earning rewards or voting. Thread Accumulation forces each identity to slowly gather interaction credits from existing participants before gaining full network access. An attacker must maintain dozens of identities over days, manually building trust signals rather than deploying thousands instantly. Ember Decay reduces each phantom identity’s influence to near zero unless it accumulates real-time participation, making rapid sybil farming futile.
